profile.name: João Vitor Vale
profile.role: Full Stack Developer · Java & Spring Boot
profile.bio: At ZeroUm Mobilidade I shipped six systems from scratch in six months, from spec to deploy: Java 21 + Spring Boot 3 back-ends with hexagonal architecture and over 1,100 automated tests, React front-ends and mobile apps. I use AI in development with a method: spec, plan, tests and review.

experiences.role: Junior Systems Analyst, working as Full Stack Developer
experiences.description: I own the internal systems of an urban mobility company operating in 9 cities: I gather requirements with the board, design the architecture, implement, test and deploy. I take part in Scrum, with Jira, alongside the team that builds the main ride-hailing app.
highlights: Two Java 21 + Spring Boot 3 back-ends (ServiJá and conTroll), with Spring Security/JWT, JPA, Flyway, Redis and over 1,100 tests.
Pradis: bulk messaging and support over the official WhatsApp API, with a serverless queue (Cloud Tasks + Cloud Functions), chatbot and role-based access.
Driver screening: background checks across 8 external sources, with a processing queue and spreadsheet batches.
Sintonia: Flutter + Firebase app published on Google Play.
Gas distribution ERP (in production): geofenced time tracking, cylinder control and a delivery app with voice navigation.

experiences.description: Office administration while studying Systems Analysis and Development.

projects.name: hexfolio
projects.description: This portfolio: its layout is the architecture of the system that serves it.
highlights: Java 25 + Spring Boot 4.2 with hexagonal architecture; the architecture map is generated from the code.
Asynchronous contact form with AWS SQS, a DLQ and an idempotent consumer.
Tested with JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, LocalStack and ArchUnit.

projects.name: ServiJá
projects.description: Services marketplace with back-end, admin panel and mobile app.
highlights: Java 21 + Spring Boot 3 with 15 business modules: auth, bookings, payments, chat and auditing.
939 back-end tests: 604 unit (JUnit 5 + Mockito) and 335 integration (Testcontainers + PostgreSQL).
PostgreSQL + Flyway (34 migrations), Redis, AWS S3 and Prometheus metrics.
GitHub Actions CI, Docker Compose and 21 ADRs.

projects.name: conTroll
projects.description: Ticketing platform (helpdesk) with SLAs, priorities and an audit trail.
highlights: Hexagonal architecture: domain, use cases, ports and adapters.
Security audit of Spring Security + JWT, with five fixes applied.
Structured logs, metrics and health checks; 167 back-end and 57 front-end tests.
